caption: The image depicts a rectangular metal relief with an arched top, predominantly gray in color, featuring raised ornamental detailing. In the center, a human figure stands on a stepped platform, facing forward, holding a sword in the right hand and a shield in the left. Two symmetrical, stylized floral motifs with vertical stems and circular blooms are on either side of the figure. The border of the panel is decorated with scrollwork and floral patterns. Above the figure, within the arched portion, there is text that reads “A T NEWCOM 1767.” The topmost part of the relief features additional ornamental flourishes within the arch. The texture is rough, indicating it is likely cast from metal or stone.
title: Fireback
